instructions: Infer the advisory operational lifecycle posture of a canonical project from observed git freshness, worktree activity, Machina handoff presence, structural ctx surface count, and source classes. Keep strictly advisory and separate from observed facts.

options.active_development: Actively worked project with recent commits (<= 14 days), dirty worktree, unpushed commits ahead of upstream, or an active Machina session handoff.
options.maintained_stable: Structured, clean codebase with governance docs, multiple subsystems, or operational surfaces and no recent churn or drift.
options.dormant_archive: Long-inactive (>= 120 days since commit) or backup/archive-only project with clean or absent live worktrees and no active handoff.
options.ephemeral_experiment: Tiny scratch spike or prototype (<= 5 files, zero operational surfaces, no governance docs, and no active continuity handoff).
